description: Align content identity, release timing and approved behavior metrics before comparing bounded observations.

guide.applicability: Use for one project content launch with exact entity, release and observation-window definitions.
guide.context_boundary: Release notes establish timing and scope only; they do not prove that the launch caused behavior changes.
steps: Resolve content identity, eligible population, release window and approved engagement/value metrics.
Align release Context with governed returned observations and preserve completeness and quality limits.
Report temporal associations, excluded concurrent changes and hypotheses without causal attribution.
guide.title: New content launch evidence review

summary: Relate returned behavior to a project launch without claiming launch causality.
